reviews.title: Not much to like about the latest update
reviews.text: I find it really irritating that the first screen isn’t the final one I looked at on my previous use of the App, but a selection of all the new tools that I can avail myself of (and - as I don’t use WA for business- will never use). In an effort to make me more efficient, the new App actually slows me down. At least the ‘icon’ for the App, on my Home Screen, has finally downloaded. For a couple of weeks it just sat there on my phone & tablets as a ‘skeleton’ of the icon it would eventually become.
